peakvi.corpus: No upstream checkpoint or pretraining corpus; only declared outer-training donor ATAC matrices

interpretation: PeakVI has no foundation-checkpoint contamination because every included model is trained locally within outer folds. Its leakage risks are training-plus-held peak unions, region filtering, data-dependent model dimensions, covariates, early stopping, query adaptation, and downstream heads. It is an ATAC latent/accessibility model, not an RNA-conditioned profile or allele-effect model, so it cannot enter the current held-back endpoints.
remaining_blockers: Activate GSE296875 only after its donor/barcode/well/reference/peak/QC/missingness authorities pass and freeze same-nucleus rows without using held donors.
Freeze explicit hidden and latent dimensions after the training-only peak contract; do not allow implicit square-root defaults to alter capacity by fold.

Freeze donor-grouped training/validation splits, peak coordinates/order, covariates, five seeds, early stopping, posterior-mean extraction, normalized-accessibility options, and local artifact hashes.
Prohibit load_query_data or any other held-row adaptation unless a separate outcome-blind lane is prospectively frozen.
Validate scvi-tools 1.5.0.post1 import, sparse data path, forward/backward, checkpoint resume, deterministic seeds, and cross-device tolerances on L40S.
Create a separate nonpromotable ATAC representation/integration TaskSpec with assay-native baselines before scheduling.
